namespace_policy: Leave every namespace alone in this migration. Path/namespace mismatches that already exist (e.g. Probability/ProductVariance.lean in namespace FunctionalInequalities.ProductVariance; BakryEmery/WeakHessian.lean in namespaces Analysis and Probability.Stein; KLS/BKL/CumulantBound.lean in KLS.BKL.Localization) stay as they are; any namespace change is a separate API migration. Audit-client namespaces (e.g. namespace HeatSemigroupAudit) also stay unchanged.
audit_basename_rule: Directory = the library family the client audits (one level under research/audits/). Basename = old basename minus the family term; the kind suffix Audit / RouteStatements is kept (README.md identifies kinds by it, as in BKL/, CEK/, Newtonian/). When stripping leaves no distinguishing term, the audited module or theorem name is used. No same-directory collisions; 2 cross-directory duplicate basenames remain intentionally (Hausdorff/ and Vector/ CriticalSliceAudit.lean mirror Analysis/{Hausdorff,Vector}/Slice/Critical.lean; BKL/ and MetricBV/ ConvexSupportAudit.lean audit different objects).
